stronger_left_out_note: 144 candidates left out or sent to review have more views or more counted sources than the lowest kept spot (0 views, 1 counted source). Each carries the judge's concrete "What qualifies" reason (event, closed to the public, minor memorial, duplicate, operator or retail, restricted site, not there whenever you arrive, or a precinct that duplicates its member institutions). The 29 with 3000+ views or 3+ sources are the ones a reader should check: Royal Military College Duntroon, Manuka Oval, Canberra Stadium, Telstra Tower (closed until December 2027), Government House, the Lodge, Floriade, Summernats, Parliamentary Triangle (review), Scrivener Dam (review), Mugga-Mugga Cottage (review), Gold Creek Village (a wrapper), Aboriginal Dreamings Gallery (retail).

strongest_outsiders.note: No kept place lies outside both spans. The strongest places outside the ACT (Queanbeyan, Googong, Bungendore and others, 40 in outside-act.json) are NSW and out of the region.

benchmark.note: The NZ benchmarks (Red Rocks, Kapiti Island, Ninety Mile Beach and so on) do not apply to the ACT. The matching tests here: TSS-Earnslaw-style vehicles and operators absent (no Corin Forest-style operator is kept except Corin Forest itself, a place with a fixed site; judged keep); a gateway village whose draw is beyond it (Tharwa) is a kept village in its own right per the judges' run rule; negative benchmarks held: a civic building seen from the street (Supreme Court of the ACT, Civic Square) rejected, a once-weekly market (Hartley Hall Markets) rejected, an event (Floriade, Summernats) rejected, a closed attraction (Telstra Tower) rejected.
